name: Karin Karlsbro - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the proposal for a Council decision on the termination of the Voluntary Partnership Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Cameroon on forest law enforcement, governance and trade in timber and derived products to the Union
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on the European Union's plan to end its timber trade agreement with Cameroon. The agreement, in force since 2011, was meant to ensure only legal timber is exported to the European Union. Cameroon never set up the required system to prove timber is legal, and forest governance got worse. Parliament regrets ending the agreement but agrees it is the best option for now, and asks the European Union to keep working with Cameroon on forests, corruption and illegal logging.

- The European Union ends its 2011 timber agreement with Cameroon; the agreement never worked as planned.
- It affects Cameroonian timber exporters, forest communities and European companies buying that timber.
- Next, the European Union and Cameroon are asked to discuss new ways to cooperate on forests.
